proposedContributions.change: Export pure strict task.createFromMessage request/result schemas using accepted RoxCommand/Rox2EntityRef types; sourceMessage required, project optional, title length 1..10000, assigneePrincipalIds required array with maximum 1000 and nonempty bounded IDs, reject extra fields including actor. Define RoxTask DTO with canonical identity/revision, description, typed source refs and assignees separate from per-principal placement. Propose AssignTask(taskRef, assigneePrincipalIds, expectedRevision) and GetSourceContext(taskRef, authorized cursor/limit) typed DTOs; source history contains human Message refs/revisions/provenance and bounded root/preceding/reply results. These latter shapes require lead acceptance; no service I/O in contracts.

Implement CreateTaskFromMessage, AssignTask and GetSourceContext through accepted policy/idempotency/revision gateway. Derive principal from authenticated transport; validate source workspace, source readability, task creation action, optional Project membership/link permission and assignee eligibility before writing. Create registry task, source derived-from edge, optional membership, assignments, command result/receipt and task.created/task.assigned/entity.linked outbox records in one transaction. Receipt replay returns original entity/result and altered-payload replay conflicts; current policy is still enforced. AssignTask uses existing aggregate revision CAS. Context reads current task AND message/thread ACL, bounded history and provenance; links/assignment never imply grants.

Use accepted transaction/registry/graph ports, scoped task rows and per-principal task_personal_placement; persist description/source/assignee data and aggregate revision. Reuse command_receipt/outbox/inbox and entity_link rather than creating parallel stores. Expose bounded authorized task/Project/source queries. Import legacy task IDs via scoped aliases/provenance, quarantine ambiguous mappings, and preserve standalone file authority separately. Provider adapters remain composition-root-owned.

Proposed additive domain migration: task and task_personal_placement with workspace/entity identity, schema/revision constraints, retained tombstones, per-principal placement identity and query indexes. Extend/reuse the accepted entity_link schema for task source and Project membership with reverse lookup indexes; do not issue a competing CREATE TABLE for an existing shared graph. Reuse accepted scoped command idempotency uniqueness, aliases and event delivery uniqueness. Backfill by scoped alias/provenance with ambiguity quarantine; pre-cutover snapshot/writer rollback, post-cutover forward repair or verified reverse replay, no recent-write deletion.

Exercise real command/query boundary with W1, A owner, B member, C outsider, PRIVATE_WP-11 and seed 20260941. Assert same-key sequential/concurrent/crash retries return one canonical task, receipt, source edge, membership and recipient effect; changed hash conflicts; revoked/forged/cross-workspace refs fail without metadata disclosure. Verify root and reply context, Project read-back, assignee attention replay, source deletion fallback and separate personal placement. Seed duplicate-on-retry and source-link/ACL/event mutants and require criterion-specific failures, distinguish infrastructure failures; independent evaluator supplies holdout. Electron/browser/native-tool scenario proof remains additional to this test, not replaced by fixtures.
